name: ry-ai-assistant
description: MCP server to create and edit Confluence pages with Requirement Yogi macros from an LLM.

scripts.generate: npm run generate:docs && npm run generate:ui
scripts.compile: npm run generate && rimraf dist && tsc
scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run build:prod && npm run build:dev && npm run build:mcpb
scripts.build:prod: npm run generate && node scripts/build-bundle.mjs prod
scripts.build:dev: npm run generate && node scripts/build-bundle.mjs dev
